verdict.rationale: Isolated test or sandbox environments are a fair question for a full-stack web framework, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented Next.js sandbox mode that keeps tests away from production data. The closest items are a cache bypass for previewing unpublished CMS content and an MCP endpoint into the running app; both are adjacent features, not sandbox isolation, and neither gets credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
